thread:
Sarah: Quick heads-up — we have a semantic-match regression hitting ~12 high-touch customers since ~03:40 UTC. Search/rerank relevance is off; some clients report dashboards returning unrelated docs. Drafting outbound now, need eng RCA + mitigation plan + suggested customer credits.
Julia: Investigating root cause. Initial trace points at the recent quantization patch for the small-encoder model. Repro locally with noisy embeddings.
Matt: Can we get an estimated rollback time? Execs will want an ETA in the comms.
Julia: Rolling back the quantization change for affected dedicated pools now. ETA ~30m for full validation, 60m to confirm restored relevance. Will update.
Diego: Drafting a short customer note. Keeping tone calm, specifics limited. Proposed items: summary of impact, what we did (rollback + reindex offer), mitigation window, 10% service credit, invite to office hours.
Sarah: Share the draft here (short). Also include a clear next-step for customers who see incorrect results (reindex + contact cs@redwood).
Diego: Draft snippet:```Hi — we’re reaching out about an issue we identified this morning that may have affected search and relevance in your account. We’ve started rolling back a configuration change and will validate results over the next hour. If you see incorrect search results please reach out to your CS rep or run a reindex (we can do this for you). We’ll follow up with an RCA and offered credit. — Redwood Inference team```
Eve (Legal): Tone looks good. Avoid wording that implies data loss. Replace "affected" with "may have experienced" and keep reindex as an optional step we perform on request.
Diego: Updated: replaced wording per legal. Also adding RSVP for a 45-min office hours session for impacted accounts at 15:00 UTC.
Sarah: Good. Can we list the impacted behavior examples without naming customers in the public note? e.g., "some queries returned low-relevance results or incorrect reranks." That should be fine.
Julia: Rollback completed on 3 pools at 04:05 UTC; telemetry shows relevance metrics trending back to baseline. Still running full validation.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-331 created, severity P2, bridge scheduled.
Matt: Thanks. Once Julia confirms validated, we send the customer note + individualized follow-ups for the top 5 renewal-risk accounts. Diego please prep high-touch script.
Diego: Will do. Preparing email + short in-product banner for impacted accounts. Will post final copy here for signoff.
Sarah: Thanks everyone — keep updates concise. I’ll coordinate exec note and list of impacted tenants for renewals team.
Julia: Final validation OK at 04:52 UTC — relevance restored across affected pools. Will attach logs and root-cause summary to the RCA doc.
Diego: Final customer note ready and uploaded to the comms folder. Sending after Sarah signs off.
Sarah: Sign-off granted. Sending now. Follow-up: schedule 1:1 outreach for renewal-risk customers and log feedback in the account health tracker. :thumbsup:
